# P08 recovery repair checkpoint

Execution-2 on 2026-10-03 resumed the approved nine-step plan at
`data/accounting-master/runs/20261003T055003-956101b1/P08/approved-plan.json`.
MC06/15/17/19/29/30 and G4/G7/G8 retain their wider obligations.

## Audit and evidence contract
Question: does applicable inspected authority support the bounded issuer-bond
lifecycle and a matched cross-standard comparison? The independent baseline is
discounted contractual cash flows, annual effective interest and funding
reconciliation. Source applicability, atomic events and reproducible stored
cases determine engineering admission; a second inspected treatment is required
for criterion 3. Missing authority vetoes that comparison, while source, arithmetic
or replay failure vetoes engineering acceptance. No stochastic ranking or new
numerical default is claimed. The approved audit still fits actual files;
failed access routes were not polled again. Synthetic yield, annual timing,
fixed shares, functional currency, excluded terms and funding remain explicit
hypotheses. Balanced journals cannot establish real-contract eligibility.

## Verified repairs
Recovered fair-value/residual-equity/amortised-cost admission, full case replay,
source-copy validation, recomputed economic hashes and prior mutation tests were
checked against actual code. Reinspected AASB 132/9/7 covers and all 12 claim
anchors. Preserved FASB partial inspection and all original failed access records.
A further defect was reproduced: corrupt AASB/FASB manifest hashes passed.
The checker now validates every manifest pin, requires all supporting inputs,
and rejects missing/unsafe paths. Three new regression tests were added.
Both AASB 132 input pins were added to the manifest. All three exact cases and
both comparison outcomes were regenerated from the engine.

tests/test_accounting_p08.py, and the three declared P08 files:
authority-and-methods.json, result.md, progr
